## Expanded Version Available

This blog post has been expanded into a comprehensive exposition covering neural network fundamentals, transformers, diffusion models, normalizing flows, grokking, manifold learning, and physics-ML connections.

**[Read the full Notes page on Machine Learning →](../notes/machine-learning.qmd)**

The original post explored diffusion models through the lens of Langevin dynamics, covering score functions, time reversal, physics applications, and normalizing flows. The expanded version adds sections on neural network fundamentals, the transformer architecture and attention mechanism, grokking and phase transitions in learning, manifold learning, and deep connections between machine learning and statistical physics.
